notes:
milk crate 0.3.0
- Tabs: each tab has its own address, layout, devices and style edits. Ctrl+T, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+1 to 9, drag to reorder. Open tabs come back on relaunch.
- In the style editor, scroll the wheel over a focused number field to change it (Shift x10, Alt x0.1).
- Settings (gear in the top bar, or Ctrl+,): search engine, home page, theme, layout for new tabs, downloads folder, clearing browsing data and updates.
- Google is the default search for anything typed in the address bar that isn't an address.
- Drag the left edge of the side panel and the top edge of the console to resize them.
- Newer iPhones (16e, 16, 16 Plus, 17 Pro, Air, 17 Pro Max) and iPhone Duo, folded and open.
- A short tour on first launch, replayable from Settings.
- Dark interface theme.
- Screenshots now save at the device's full size.
- milk crate checks for updates and installs them.
